visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ list of questions and answers
visualCharacteristics.layout: default: grey question bars with +/- toggle, answer opens below; plain: ruled open list with a ▸ toggle; open: grey boxes with a left rule, question heading and answer always visible, no toggle

contentPattern.structure: summary (question, plain text) | text (answer, rich text)

options.label: Open (all answers visible in grey boxes, no toggle)

reuseGuidance: Use the default for collapsible FAQs, 'plain' for the ruled open list, 'open' when every answer must be visible (product page FAQs).
